title: Beyond Space: Quantum Solutions for AI Energy Needs
summary: AI’s energy demands are driving interest in space-based data centers, but quantum computing offers a practical, energy-efficient solution available today.
body_markdown: As tech companies explore space-based data centers to meet the massive energy demands of AI, quantum computing offers a more practical near-term alternative. With real-world applications already in production, quantum computing provides a path to reduce compute demands and energy use today.
